job_description_lines.text: Oversee daily opening and closing checklists for the Gulshan branch.
Reconcile daily POS cash receipts against bank deposit slips.
Coordinate monthly fire safety and facility inspections.

turns.text: Walk me through the recurring tasks you handle every week at the Gulshan branch.

Every Thursday afternoon I reconcile the branch cash ledger and upload the deposit receipts before 4 PM. I also approve emergency courier dispatches whenever regional branches run out of receipt rolls.
